`parallel.ole` is an Apache-2.0 MTEF test fixture copied from
MTEF-py-FIX 1.0.1 (`tests/data/parallel.mtef`, commit
`08818cf79ee10df67cc804d486c1fd9d772e189d`). Its source equation decodes to
`OC\parallel`; it is used only to test embedded editable formula conversion.
See the repository `THIRD_PARTY.md` and the vendored package's `LICENSE` and
`NOTICE` files.
